answer: A newcomer proves themselves at the canyon signal. They lock a $6 bond, light one signal across the canyon, and mark it with yarrow from one real task. Two watchers on opposite rims read it within the hour and check the mark; a match returns the bond. A copied signal, a mark with no task behind it, or a late reading burns the bond and leaves the name on the wall. One hundred fakes would burn $600 and light one hundred signals.
